purpose: Replay frozen #50/#54 and #51/#55 classification evidence against ISS66 U04B/U04C admission requirements without rewriting historical candidate claims.

admission_requirements.component_evidence: All five difficulty components have question-specific evidence against the canonical 0/1/2 rubric.
admission_requirements.normalized_demand_basis: grade9v3:cognitive_demand carries primary/secondary/basis and is bound by the QRT resolver to the canonical crux.

d2.prior_disagreement: Q6 and Q10 demonstrate material band divergence; Q10 also differs in primary demand.
d2.reason: Neither frozen run satisfies the U04B evidence admission shape; #50 evidence lane also lacks canonical crux binding.

d3.prior_disagreement: Q8 converges on JUSTIFY but differs D4 vs D3; multiple other items differ in band/demand.
d3.reason: Both frozen banks have crux routes, but neither has per-component evidence or normalized demand basis. Crux selections themselves also differ on some matched items, so replay must re-author evidence rather than compare labels alone.

rationale: The U04D gate only adds shared adjudication machinery when two independently admissible classifications under the same evidence contract still disagree. No frozen cohort currently meets that admission bar.
next_use: Treat #50/#54 and #51/#55 as calibration fixtures requiring fresh evidence authoring under U04B/U04C before their classifications can be compared for adjudication.
